static_traits.name: Zhang Kai
static_traits.educational_background: Currently studying for a bachelor's degree
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk to, but unwilling to share financial and academic struggles, with tension in some relationships
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before or other psychological issues; no similar problems experienced before

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and stressed about finances and academic performance; last semester, after realizing some courses were being failed and debts kept accumulating, Anxiety worsened markedly, with intense Anxiety almost daily when Receiving grades or debt notices; trying to ignore the problems only increases Anxiety and stress.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because feeling overwhelmed and unable to cope with academic and financial difficulties alone, hoping for support to relieve stress and improve coping.
growth_experiences: Last semester, the client realized some courses were being failed while debts kept accumulating, feeling everything was out of control. Whenever Receiving grades or debt notices, Anxiety spikes, with thoughts of 'there is no way out'; daily worries about the future, debt management, and academic load trigger Academics affected, Interpersonal tension, and Daily rhythm disrupted. The client tries to cope by ignoring the problems, but Anxiety and stress only worsen.

core_beliefs: I lack the ability to handle academic and financial problems
My future will be ruined by failure and debt

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one evaluation goes poorly or debts appear, it means I lack ability and my future will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding and ignoring bills or grade information to temporarily lower Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be trapped by debt; this semester is over

special_situations.event: Realizing some courses are being failed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail one course, it means I will fail everything, showing I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing on the worst outcome, panicking instead of using available resources (e.g., extra credit, tutoring)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail all my courses, and after that everything is over

special_situations.event: Examines own income and debt (annual salary about $100,000, debt about $20,000)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as debt exists, it means I am a failure and am being destroyed by debt
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores the positives (stable income and repayment ability), focusing attention only on the debt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I earn 100k a year but have 20k in debt, and this is ruining me

special_situations.event: Before a project evaluation (previously believed it would fail)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel not ready, I am bound to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Panics in the present moment, finds balanced thinking difficult
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely fail this project

core_conflict.wish: Longing to regain control and stability over academics and finances, easing Anxiety and receiving support
core_conflict.fear: Fear of failure, being trapped by debt long-term, and a future out of control
defense_goal: Temporarily lowering Anxiety and maintaining psychological stability by avoiding and ignoring unfavorable information

object_relations.self_representation: An isolated person swept up by stress and a possible failure
object_relations.object_representation: The outside (professors, debt agencies) is experienced as harsh judges or a continuous source of pressure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When reminded of or asked about academic grades and debt status (such as receiving professor feedback or a debt notice)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting this external information as negation of my abilities and a 'failure verdict', feeling everything is out of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tending to skip details quickly, speaking vaguely of 'nothing much', or saying 'I do not want to talk about this', in a tense but ostensibly calm tone; when pressed, Displacement to more Average topics.

manifestations: Feeling choice and control constrained under financial burden and Academic pressure
Daily worries about the future and debt management, experiencing 'no way out'
Unwilling to discuss financial and academic struggles with friends
outcomes: Insufficient sense of support, Increasing stress

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact
manifestations: Trying to ignore problems (bills, grades, etc.) to avoid directly facing Anxiety triggers

exception_events.target_problem: When facing course projects or exams, the client usually catastrophizes that they will inevitably fail, followed by panic and difficulty concentrating
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once, before a project began, was convinced they would fail, but ultimately passed and got a decent grade
exception_events.reason: Clue: although panicking at the moment, still completed the project tasks; actual grade feedback shows the worst outcome is not the only possibility, thereby forming evidence usable for self-correction.

positive_force: Has performed acceptably in some assignments and other course exams, showing a certain learning ability
A past project that was eventually passed, serving as counter-evidence that 'worry does not equal reality'
Willing to proactively seek counseling support; positive attitude
Has a relatively high income (annual salary about 100,000), with debt repayment potential
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases: catastrophizing, mental filtering, negating the positive, etc.
Intense Anxiety when Receiving grades or debt reminders, easily jumping to the worst outcome
Tending to avoid problems (trying to ignore bills and grades), leading to worsened Anxiety
Unwilling to discuss struggles with friends, with insufficient use of social support
Academic pressure and financial burden coexisting, forming double pressure

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Anxiety and panic when Receiving grades or debt-related information, avoiding checking or handling such matters
antecedent: Receiving grades feedback or debt notices
Thinking about academic progress and debt status
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic cognitions and excessive negative focus (mental filtering) formed under performance pressure and financial burden, fearing 'no way out'
target_behavior.function: Short-term escape from discomfort and Anxiety, trying to gain temporary psychological relief by avoiding information
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance, Interpersonal tension, disrupted daily life, continuously worsening Anxiety and stress
